_help.site_name: Required. Shown on the report. The physical site/building.
_help.client: Optional. Legal client name for the report + invoice trail.
_help.technician: Optional. Who ran the audit. Defaults to Ark Web Solutions.
_help.cidrs: Required. List of PRIVATE (RFC-1918) ranges to scan, CIDR form. Public ranges are refused. Examples: 10.0.0.0/24, 172.16.5.0/24, 192.168.1.0/24.
_help.extra_ports: Optional. Extra TCP ports to probe on top of the built-in curated list (e.g. [1883, 5000]).
_help.timeout: Optional. Seconds to wait per TCP probe. Lower = faster but may miss slow devices. 0.6 is a good default on a LAN.
_help.workers: Optional. How many probes run at once. 120 is fine for a /24. Raise for large ranges, lower on flaky Wi-Fi.
